Chapter 181: It's Late, Let's Do Something Else

On New Year's Eve.

There were only two or three minutes left before the final countdown.

Li Luo, along with Ying Chanxi and Xu Youyu, went downstairs into the Bihai Lanting residential community.

Worried about being chased away by security, the three of them simply walked out of the community gate and went to an entrance near Yinshan.

This was a small park, and there was no one around this late at night.

Li Luo stopped here, holding the plastic bag, and poured out all the fireworks he had bought.

Since it wasn't the Spring Festival yet, the supermarket didn't sell the big fireworks that could whoosh up into the sky. Most of them were smaller types.

Like sparklers, poppers, and so on.

Li Luo lined up three of the fountain fireworks in a row, not in a hurry to light them. He then opened the sparkler packaging, took out a few, and handed them to the two girls.

Taking out a newly bought lighter from the plastic bag, Li Luo helped them light their sparklers.

As specks of fire lit up, the star-like sparklers bloomed in their hands.

"So pretty."

Ying Chanxi waved the sparkler in her hand, writing words in the night sky.

But Xu Youyu felt it wasn't exciting enough. After her sparkler went out, she asked Li Luo, "Are there any bigger ones?"

"Then try this one." Li Luo smiled and handed a long, tube-shaped firework from the ground to Xu Youyu, letting her rest it on her shoulder.

"What's this?"

"A Gatling gun." After confirming it was safe, Li Luo said, "You hold this. Just don't aim the muzzle at Chanxi and me. There's no one else around, so you can shoot wherever you want."

"Eh?" Xu Youyu was stunned for a moment. "This will shoot out directly?"

"Try it and you'll know." Li Luo lit the fuse of the Gatling gun and then reminded her, "It's starting. Don't let go, hold it steady."

The moment he finished speaking, Xu Youyu heard a whoosh next to her ear.

A single missile shot out and exploded about ten meters away, forming a small firework bloom.

After that, a firework shot out from the tube on Xu Youyu's shoulder almost every second. As long as she turned her body and controlled the direction, she could make the fireworks shoot wherever she wanted.

"I've never played with this before." Xu Youyu said, full of excitement, "This is awesome."

Seeing this, Ying Chanxi on the side also picked up a Gatling gun from the ground and had Li Luo light it for her.

And so, soon after, two Gatling guns were firing back and forth in the small park.

After the two had their fun, the time was approaching midnight, the New Year's crossover.

The three of them took out their phones, watching the time tick away.

As it was about to cross the threshold of the last moment of 2014, Li Luo took out the lighter and lit the fountain fireworks he had lined up one by one.

With a sizzling sound.

Three firework fountains bloomed in the open space of the small park.

Time flowed on, steadily and eternally moving forward, stepping through the gate of 2015.

"Happy New Year," Ying Chanxi said softly, standing beside Li Luo with her hands clasped together.

"Happy New Year!" Xu Youyu said happily, lighting another sparkler for herself to add to the fun.

"Happy New Year." Li Luo smiled, patting Ying Chanxi on the shoulder and signaling for her to take out the Polaroid camera she had brought.

The three of them stood with their backs to the fountain fireworks, captured in the lens of Ying Chanxi's Polaroid, becoming a group photo of fireworks on New Year's Eve.

"I should have asked Zhusheng to come with us." Looking at the three people in the photo, Ying Chanxi suddenly felt a little sad, feeling guilty and disappointed about her earlier selfish thoughts.

If she had known it would turn out like this, what would it have mattered to have Yan Zhusheng join them?

At least it would have been more lively.

The thought of Yan Zhusheng still in her dorm room while the three of them were outside setting off fireworks made Ying Chanxi feel a bit bad.

And just as she was thinking this, Ying Chanxi felt her phone vibrate.

She took it out and saw it was a text from Yan Zhusheng.

It briefly said, "Happy New Year."

Ying Chanxi blinked, pursed her lips, and immediately replied to Yan Zhusheng with a "Happy holidays" as well.

Then she looked up and saw that Li Luo and Xu Youyu were also looking at their phones. She couldn't help but ask curiously, "Did Zhusheng text you guys too?"

"Yeah." Xu Youyu nodded and said with some regret, "It's a shame Zhusheng is still spending the night at the dorm. It would have been great if the four of us could have celebrated the New Year together."

"Yeah... um..." Ying Chanxi lowered her head and sighed, "It's all my fault. I should have just dragged her back with us after school."

"It's already come to this, so don't say things like that." Li Luo watched as the fountain fireworks gradually died down, then squatted to put the remaining fireworks back into the plastic bag. He then said with a smile, "Instead of regretting it here, let's take action. Follow me."

After speaking, Li Luo strode forward.

Ying Chanxi and Xu Youyu exchanged a puzzled glance. Seeing the direction Li Luo was headed, they had a guess and quickly jogged to catch up.

The three of them crossed the intersection and circled around to the south side of the No. 1 Affiliated High School's dormitory area.

Then, Li Luo once again took out two Gatling guns and placed them on Xu Youyu's and Ying Chanxi's shoulders.

He didn't light them right away. Instead, he took out his phone and gave Yan Zhusheng a call.

"Hello? Li Luo?"

The call was answered instantly.

Yan Zhusheng's voice came from the other end.

"Where are you?" Li Luo looked up at the dormitory building opposite them and asked with a smile.

"I'm in bed," Yan Zhusheng said honestly. "What's up?"

"Then guess where we are?" Li Luo didn't answer, asking another question instead.

"Um..." Yan Zhusheng paused, not understanding Li Luo's meaning. "You're... also in bed?"

"Of course not." Li Luo was a bit speechless. "We're out on the street."

"Oh." Yan Zhusheng still didn't realize what was so special about this. "What are you doing on the street?"

"Heh." Li Luo let out a puff of white breath, then smiled. "Get out of bed now, go to your balcony, and look at the road opposite. You'll know what we're doing." Hearing Li Luo's words, Yan Zhusheng finally understood.

Then, the sound of someone getting out of bed came from the other end of the line.

"Hiss... Mmm..."

Li Luo heard a cry of pain from Yan Zhusheng over the phone and couldn't help but frown and ask, "What happened to you?"

"I got out of bed too fast and stubbed my toe..." Yan Zhusheng pursed her lips, frowning as she endured the pain. "I'm fine."

As she spoke, Yan Zhusheng had already reached the balcony and was looking curiously across the road.

It was already past midnight, and hardly anyone could be seen on the street.

Almost immediately, Yan Zhusheng noticed the three figures on the other side.

Li Luo raised his hand and waved at Yan Zhusheng on the dorm balcony. Then, while helping Xu Youyu and Ying Chanxi light their Gatling guns, he said to Yan Zhusheng on the phone, "Although you can't come over, we can put on a firework show for you."

After he spoke.

The Gatling guns began to glow blue.

One after another, fireworks shot straight into the sky, blooming at a height roughly parallel to the dormitory building.

Although they weren't as magnificent as large fireworks, in Yan Zhusheng's eyes, they were the most beautiful fireworks she had ever seen in her life.

"Can Zhusheng see them?" Xu Youyu leaned close to Li Luo and shouted excitedly into the phone in his hand.

"Yes, I can see them," Yan Zhusheng nodded in response. "They're beautiful."

"Happy New Year, Zhusheng." Ying Chanxi also came closer, squeezing in on Li Luo's other side, and said to Yan Zhusheng, "You can come over early tomorrow. We can go grocery shopping together."

"Okay." Yan Zhusheng nodded, looking at the fireworks blooming before her, the three figures across the road, and listening to the voices on the phone.

At this moment, she felt a warmth in her heart, a warm current flowing through her entire body.

It had been a little chilly coming out to the balcony in her pajamas, but now she didn't feel cold at all.

"Alright, that's about it."

After the Gatling guns were finished, Li Luo said to Yan Zhusheng, "You should go back inside your room. Don't catch a cold."

"Oh." Yan Zhusheng nodded, waved at the three across the street, and obediently turned to go back inside.

But neither of them hung up the phone.

Li Luo just kept the call on speakerphone and walked home with the two girls beside him. As they walked, the four of them continued to chat over the phone.

Most of the time, it was Xu Youyu and Ying Chanxi chattering away, with Yan Zhusheng occasionally replying with a word or two.

Li Luo acted as the manual laborer holding the phone, rarely getting a word in.

By the time they finally got home, Xu Youyu was already a bit sleepy. She called out a "good night" to Yan Zhusheng on the phone, then waved at Li Luo and Ying Chanxi and went back to her bedroom to get ready for sleep.

Li Luo and Ying Chanxi also said good night to Yan Zhusheng, and then Li Luo hung up.

But after watching Xu Youyu close her door, Ying Chanxi's eyes darted around slightly. She suddenly asked Li Luo in a low voice, "Are you going to sleep?"

"What's wrong?" Li Luo gave her a strange look.

"Um... I don't really feel sleepy." Ying Chanxi's eyes flickered. She didn't look at Li Luo, instead averting her gaze elsewhere, twisting her fingers behind her back. She said quietly, "Should we find something else to do?"

"What do you want to do?" Li Luo raised an eyebrow. "Our senior has gone to sleep. It's no fun for just two people to play cards, is it?"

"We can think of something else."

"Hmm..." Li Luo stroked his chin, then looked Ying Chanxi up and down, a playful expression appearing in his eyes.

Ying Chanxi's cheeks flushed red under his gaze, and she shyly lowered her head. "What... what are you thinking?"

"Nothing. I just didn't expect you to be so proactive."

"What... what proactive or not... What are you talking about, I don't understand at all." Ying Chanxi's eyes darted around in a panic, but her heart was thumping wildly.

Li Luo had already walked up to her, a faint smile on his face, and reached out to pat her on the head.

"It must have been hard for you to wait until now," Li Luo chuckled. "Now that our senior isn't here, you can finally do something shameful, right?"

"You..." Ying Chanxi didn't expect Li Luo to be so direct. She felt like her head was about to steam, and she stammered, at a loss for words.

But in the next second, Li Luo said, "Alright, don't be shy. If you want to bark like a puppy, do it quickly. Since you're honoring your bet, three barks will be enough."

As soon as he said this.

Ying Chanxi froze on the spot, staring blankly at Li Luo.

Li Luo gave her a strange look. "What's wrong? Are you afraid our senior will hear?"

"Then why don't you do it in my room."

"Oh right, don't forget the pig oinks, too."

Hearing Li Luo's words, Ying Chanxi's small fists slowly clenched.

She took a deep breath, gritting her teeth, her anger about to erupt.

But just then, Xu Youyu's bedroom door opened.

Xu Youyu peeked out at the two in the living room and asked curiously, "What are you guys talking about? Aren't you going to sleep?"

"N-nothing..." Ying Chanxi's anger was instantly cut short. She quickly stammered an explanation, "We were just talking. Since we're not sleepy yet, we thought we'd find a movie to watch. We're discussing which movie to watch."

"Huh? Watch a movie?" Xu Youyu's eyes lit up. "Then let's watch together?"

"Aren't you going to sleep, Senior?"

"Aiya, I'll be wide awake after washing my face." Xu Youyu came out of her bedroom and walked straight into the bathroom. "Wait for me, I'll be right there!"

Watching Xu Youyu's back as she walked out of the bedroom, Ying Chanxi took a deep breath.

Then, she stomped on Li Luo's foot and huffily walked into his bedroom.

"Hiss... Why'd you step on me?" Li Luo cried out in pain and followed her into the bedroom.

Ying Chanxi puffed out her cheeks and said nothing, not wanting to bother with him.

Seeing her like this, Li Luo shook his head helplessly and turned on his computer.

After Xu Youyu finished washing her face and came into the room, he asked the two of them, "What movie should we watch?"

(End of this chapter)
